view_title: Column grid master for บ้านครอบครัวไทยเป็นสุข 5 (2-storey RC house). Four printed x-lines 1..4 at 3.50/2.20/3.00 m (8.70 m overall) and six printed y-lines ง'/ง/ค'/ค/ข/ก over 11.40 m overall. Taken from S-01 (หน้า19, แปลนฐานราก+แปลนชั้นล่าง 1:100), cross-checked against S-01/1 (หน้า20, แปลนฐานรากแผ่) and S-02 (หน้า21, แปลนชั้นบน). Origin = ง × 1, the topmost/leftmost *named* line; the two printed prime lines ง' and ค' therefore sit at negative / intermediate positions.

x_lines.source: S-01 หน้า19 (แปลนชั้นล่าง, printed 0.80 left of grid 1); S-02 หน้า21 (same 0.80 on the ง'''-ค' side wing)
x_lines.note: Side/bay-window projection west of grid 1. Beam B3 runs on this line. The sheet prints 0.80 from grid 1; the beam CENTRELINE scales at about 0.71 m, i.e. the printed 0.80 is to the outer face of a 0.20 m beam. Recorded as printed per §4 (never guess a pos_m) - a consumer computing spans off this line may be ~0.10 m long.

x_lines.source: S-02 หน้า21 (printed sub-chain 1.70 | 1.80 under the 3.50 bay)
x_lines.note: Interior beam line on the upper floor only (separates slab S2 from the B2A bay). 1.70 + 1.80 closes exactly against the printed 3.50 grid-1-to-grid-2 bay.

x_lines.source: S-01 หน้า19 (printed 0.60 right of grid 2, entrance-step B1 stub between ง''' and ง)
x_lines.note: Carries the short B1 stub beside the front entrance. The printed 0.60 spans face-to-face across BOTH the grid-2 beam and this one, so the beam centreline scales at only grid 2 + 0.42; the printed 0.60 is recorded per §4 rather than the arithmetic, and the ~0.18 m disagreement is flagged here. This is the least certain line in the master.

x_lines.source: S-02 หน้า21 (printed 0.30 right of grid 3)
x_lines.note: Upper-floor beam line B3C just east of grid 3, bounding the stair/bathroom core.

x_lines.source: S-01 หน้า19 (printed 1.10 right of grid 3)
x_lines.note: Ground-floor beam line B1 east of grid 3, bounding slab S2 / the rear terrace.

x_lines.source: S-01 หน้า19 (printed 0.60 right of grid 4, rear service strip with B1 beams)
x_lines.note: Narrow service strip east of grid 4 carrying the B1 beams and the (S) slab panels beside the rear terrace.

y_lines.source: S-01 หน้า19 + S-02 หน้า21 (front porch / balcony beam line B2A-B2B, 1.00 m in front of ง')
y_lines.note: Front edge of the entrance porch (ground floor) and of the หลังคาไก่ +5.10 porch roof (upper floor). The only printed dimension across it is 3.90 on the carport side, measured to outer faces; 3.90 - 0.10 (half of the 0.20 m ง beam) = 3.80 from ง, i.e. 1.00 m in front of ง'. Both S-01 and S-02 scale this gap at 0.95-1.02 m, so 1.00 m is the reading taken.
PRINTED on the sheet in its own bubble, exactly like ง/ค/ข/ก - not an inferred dummy. Recorded verbatim per §0.3.

y_lines.source: S-01 หน้า19 (printed 2.00 + 0.80 sub-chain between ง' and ง); S-02 หน้า21 (B2D beam line)
y_lines.note: Real beam line: B2A on the ground floor, B2D on the upper floor. 2.00 (ง'→here) + 0.80 (here→ง) closes exactly against the printed 2.80 ง'-to-ง gap.

y_lines.source: S-01 หน้า19 (beam B2 from grid 3 to grid 4); S-02 หน้า21 (printed 2.00 + 1.20 sub-chain between ง and ค')
y_lines.note: Real beam line on both floors. The printed 2.00 (ง→here) + 1.20 (here→ค') closes exactly against the 3.20 ง-to-ค' gap, and the ground-floor B2 beam between grid 3 and grid 4 scales onto it to within 0.10 m.
PRINTED on the sheet in its own bubble. Sits 0.80 m above ค; the sheet's own naming does not follow the §4 above/left rule (it would be ง'), and is kept exactly as printed per §0.3.

y_lines.source: S-01 หน้า19 + S-02 หน้า21 (lower 45° corner of the west bay window)
y_lines.note: Where the west wall steps back out from 1' to grid 1 on a 45° cut. Taken as 0.80 above ข so the cut is a true 45° matching the 0.80 offset of 1'; the sheet prints 0.65 there, which scales to the OUTER face of the same cut. The upper 45° cut needs no dummy - it runs from (grid 1, ค') to (1', ค) and both ends are already named lines.
